description: This source file implements the 'GeneratedBatchContainer' class, which provides an implementation of the 'IBatchContainer' interface for handling generated event payloads within the Orleans streaming framework. It includes properties for stream identification, sequence tokens, enqueue time, and payload, along with methods to retrieve events and handle request context imports.

classes.name: GeneratedBatchContainer
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IBatchContainer for generated event payloads, encapsulating stream ID, sequence token, enqueue time, and payload.

methods.name: GetEvents
methods.description: Returns an enumerable containing a single tuple pairing the payload cast to type T with the sequence token.

methods.name: ImportRequestContext
methods.description: Indicates whether to import the request context; always returns false in this implementation.
